name: International Islamic University Chittagong
description: Undergraduate programs, published costs and admission requirements from the university’s own website.

documents.title: IIUC undergraduate programs & published costs
documents.text: Official page snapshot, checked 25 November 2026; not a live quotation. IIUC lists these 4-year bachelor programs and total program costs: CSE BDT 717,725 (first installment 110,925); EEE 691,075 (103,750); Civil Engineering 705,325 (127,050); BBA 530,245 (89,685); English Language and Literature 384,165 (76,625). Other listed programs include CCE, ETE, Pharmacy, Finance, Economics and Banking, Arabic Language and Literature, Law, QSIS, SHIS and DIS. These are published total program costs, not semester costs or per-credit rates. Confirm the applicable intake and any changes directly on the official page.

documents.title: IIUC admission requirements
documents.text: The page checked on 25 November 2026 gives general requirements: GPA at least 2.50 in each SSC/equivalent and HSC/equivalent examination, OR one GPA may be 2.00 if the combined GPA is at least 6.00. Engineering programs CSE, EEE, ETE, CCE and Civil also require passes in Physics and Higher Mathematics in HSC/A-Level. The page excludes GED and HSC/equivalent passed before 2022. Pharmacy has additional grades, combined GPA and passing-year requirements; consult the full official notice. Meeting minimums does not guarantee selection. This limited summary omits other qualification-specific rules. Intake dates are not imported here: consult the original notice for current dates.

name: East Delta University
description: A source collection covering offered programs and the university’s published admission FAQ.

documents.title: EDU undergraduate program list
documents.text: The East Delta University admissions page lists these undergraduate programs: BBA; BSc in Business Administration and Artificial Intelligence; BSc in Computer Science and Engineering; BSc in Electrical and Electronic Engineering; BSc in Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering; BA in English; BSc in Economics. This snapshot was checked on 25 November 2026. The imported extract contains no tuition rates, total program fees, GPA cutoffs, or application deadlines. Do not infer those from another university or an old intake heading. Check the official program pages and current admission notice for those details.

documents.title: EDU admissions FAQ
documents.text: EDU’s FAQ says applicants with HSC, O Levels in 5 subjects and A Levels in 2 subjects, American High School Diploma, BTEC or compatible examinations can apply for undergraduate study. Applicants awaiting results may seek provisional admission; the university makes the final decision. Applicants with other educational backgrounds may seek Enrollment Board review. Required documents include previous certificates, mark sheets and other documents named on the application form. The FAQ describes an application fee of BDT 1,000 and directs students to program pages for tuition and to the scholarship website or office for financial-support details. This FAQ is a dated snapshot, not a guarantee of current policy; verify amounts and conditions with EDU before applying.
